crux: horizontal distance of the TV's wall plane from the nadir: plinth-front floor edge x=295.6 (X=1.21 m) vs marble wall meeting the horizontal plinth top at x=219.0 (X=1.54 m); L = 1.0457 x X_face
fault_found: DeepSeek runs (and blend component B=1.26) used the plinth front-face floor edge as the wall; marble texture and wall joint lines end at x=219 and the plinth top is horizontal (fireplace end edge constant y), so the wall is 0.31 m further out; their geometry reproduces 1.27, the correct one gives 1.58
lesson: When a wall-mounted object's distance comes from a wall-floor line in a top-down view, confirm that the line belongs to the wall and not to a low piece of furniture in front of it, by checking where the wall's texture and vertical joint lines end and whether the surface in between is horizontal (edges of constant image coordinate) or vertical (radial edges).
